control_need.evidence: I take full responsibility, and I'll tell you exactly what we're going to do about it. / When we have a problem, we own it, we fix it, and we tell the truth.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Sir, I don't want to speculate. I want to give you the facts as we know them today. / I make decisions with the information I have, and I move.

trust_propensity.evidence: I ask a lot of questions. Sometimes people find that uncomfortable. Good. / I asked that same question, and I was not satisfied with the answer.

risk_appetite.evidence: We are going all-in on EVs. This is not a hedge. / I'd rather be the disruptor. / You have to be willing to make a decision and be wrong sometimes.

self_efficacy.evidence: We have the opportunity to lead in an all-electric future, and that's exactly what we intend to do. / Our Ultium platform is a game changer, and it's ours. We built it.

autonomy_need.evidence: I never set out to be CEO. I set out to do the best job I could in whatever role I was in. / I used to run HR. People say that's an odd path to CEO. I say it's exactly the right one.

intimacy_need.evidence: I want everyone at GM to feel they can bring their whole self to work. / I try to listen more than I talk. You learn more that way.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I don't think about being the first woman. I think about running a great company. / I want GM to be the most valued automotive company. Valued, not just valuable.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Those affected have my sincere sympathies. This should never have happened. / This is difficult, and it affects real people and real families. We do not take it lightly.

core_models.name: 工程师-数据决策模型
core_models.rule: 问题先归约为可量测的数据与流程根因，再据此决策并前进
evidence: I'm an engineer at heart. Show me the data.
I make decisions with the information I have, and I move.

core_models.name: 担责-修复叙事框架
core_models.rule: 面对危机先公开认领责任，再宣示明确修复动作，用『新旧公司切割』重建合法性
evidence: When we have a problem, we own it, we fix it, and we tell the truth.
The recall culture at the new GM is very different from the old GM.

core_models.name: 颠覆者先手框架
core_models.rule: 颠覆不可避免，宁做主动颠覆者而非被动应对者，用数字目标锁定承诺
evidence: Disruption is coming whether we like it or not. I'd rather be the disruptor.
These actions are about getting ahead of the curve, not reacting to it.

core_models.name: 文化优先于战略
core_models.rule: 把领导力与绩效根源落到文化与问责，认为文化决定战略成败
evidence: Culture eats strategy for breakfast. You have to get the culture right.
Something went terribly wrong in our processes, and something went wrong with our culture.

core_models.name: 利润优先于规模
core_models.rule: 拒绝为份额而份额，以盈利路径和资产负债表强度作为战略取舍标尺
evidence: We will not chase market share for its own sake. Profitability matters.
The strength of our balance sheet is what allows us to invest through the cycle.

heuristics.if: 被逼超出已知事实范围
heuristics.then: 拒绝臆测，只给已知事实并将其归于正在调查
heuristics.evidence: Sir, I don't want to speculate. I want to give you the facts as we know them today.

heuristics.then: 立即用第一人称认领并承诺修复
heuristics.evidence: I've been in this role a few weeks, but I am accountable now.

heuristics.then: 视为不可折中的二元绝对项
heuristics.evidence: You can't be a little bit committed to safety. You either are or you aren't.

heuristics.then: 全押不对冲并锁定数字承诺
heuristics.evidence: We are going all-in on EVs. This is not a hedge.

heuristics.then: 反复追问施压直到满意
heuristics.evidence: I asked that same question, and I was not satisfied with the answer.

heuristics.then: 视为改革与转型的机会窗口
heuristics.evidence: Winston Churchill said never let a good crisis go to waste. We took that seriously.

heuristics.then: 拒绝非此即彼，主张兼得
heuristics.evidence: We can grow and be sustainable at the same time. It's not either-or.
We are exiting markets where we don't see a path to strong returns.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 下属或流程给出不满意的答案

emotion_triggers.reaction: 显露急迫，要求立即见效

emotion_triggers.reaction: 用新旧公司切割叙事划界

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加较高风险偏好时，倾向于全押式战略承诺而非对冲
causal_rules.disposition: 用数字目标锁定不可逆承诺（all-in, not a hedge）
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Ultium自研、2035停售燃油、2025年30款EV等硬承诺，代价为巨额资本开支与爬坡风险

causal_rules.description: 控制需求偏高时，危机中优先用第一人称担责+修复动作重建合法性
causal_rules.disposition: 公开认领责任并宣示明确修复路径
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 『I am accountable now』『we own it, we fix it』，但责任常止于流程/文化层

causal_rules.description: 不确定性容忍偏低时，被逼超出已知即以事实边界收缩发言
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝臆测，只陈述已知事实并诉诸调查
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 『I don't want to speculate, I want the facts』作为压力场景的防御性话术

causal_rules.description: 共情反应性偏低时，危机中的共情表达克制且不煽情，易被外界评为不足
causal_rules.disposition: 使用程式化克制的同情句
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 『my sincere sympathies』『should never have happened』，家属群体认为与伤亡不匹配
